comments_data.body: Hmmm, @lebaphi .  I hadn't used this way of deleting items before.  But, I note that while shapes get deleted mil-symbols don't.  Could you look in to that please?

Checked on branch '2805-cut-layer-issue', now 'Cut Layers' can't cut multi layers as before. @lebaphi  Could you check again?


https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/d411c56b-84e8-4c4f-af1c-9792516b50c3

Sorry for wrong screencast before. I've updated it.

Checked on branch '2805-cut-layer-issue'.  'Cut Layers' can cut multi items but it can't cut circle layers. @lebaphi Please help me check the screencast.

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/46f5f06d-5f25-40d2-a940-5a2df42aa6e9

> Hmmm, @lebaphi . I hadn't used this way of deleting items before. But, I note that while shapes get deleted mil-symbols don't. Could you look in to that please?

Hi @IanMayo, I've checked in this url https://www.geoman.io/demo and it has the same behavior. So I think this is the behavior of Geoman.
Hi @Tristina1788, I pushed the fixes, can you help to verify it again 😄

Hello @lebaphi - I've just had a play, and the issue is still present.  

Sometimes after an item has been deleted, it re-appears when a new item has been added.  Or, I'm unable to add new items.

Can you try to recognise the pattern @Tristina1788 , and provide a recording of what you see?

> Hi @IanMayo, I've checked in this url https://www.geoman.io/demo and it has the same behavior. So I think this is the behavior of Geoman.

Yes, you are completely right @lebaphi 

I have captured the issue here: https://github.com/geoman-io/leaflet-geoman/issues/1452

Hi @Tristina1788, when you cut, Geoman will remove many items at once, which will cause the data to be saved to the database asynchronously. To solve this problem, I put all the pending deleted items into the queue and deleted them one by one, that's why you see it blinked

Well, @lebaphi  and @Tristina1788 - the GeoMan didn't see it as a bug report, but as a feature request.  I wasn't expecting that:
https://github.com/geoman-io/leaflet-geoman/issues/1452#issuecomment-1936225607

_Sometime_ I'll have a look at the GeoMan code, and see if I can produce a PR.

Aah, @lebaphi - the _tidy_ way to handle this is to remove the `cutLayers` button, please.  We can reinstate it if/when GeoMan either fix the issue, or we implement it ourselves.

Now the 'Cut layers' button is removed as expected.

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/2ba6d721-2bb4-4ae5-bf2c-1b75acc35d39)

@IanMayo  In this PR, we remove 'Cut Layer' button in Core mapping tool. So now it works as expected. I think we can close the ticket. 

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/74118879-c7d6-4077-8dae-113223e0621e)

issues.title: Items are created after delete by 'Cut Layers'
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Items are created after delete by 'Cut Layers' 

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Click on action 'Cut Layers'
4. Draw the cut line to cut some layers
5. Notice these items are deleted on map
6. Draw layer to create new one item
7. Notice the items (from step 5) are showed on map

More details from below screencast

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Items are not recreated after delete by 'Cut Layers' 

## 🖥️ Screencasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/acb0dd81-d7a0-48c1-b391-fa11b010dcee

## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
